method: Each scene is posed deterministically by game/src/snapshots.js (cars placed, cruisers lit, HUD state set directly) and captured with headless Chrome's own screenshot at 1280x720 with a virtual-time budget, then transcoded to JPEG without any pixel editing.

scenes.lens: 62 degree game FOV, camera 10.6 m behind the car at 3.1 m height — the standard driving camera pulled in slightly for the portrait.
scenes.name: cover
scenes.note: Proves the open world at street level: rain, lit windows, traffic in both lanes, the FIRST PARCEL objective banner, live minimap and the full driving HUD.
scenes.rig: Low chase camera behind and to the right of the car, looking down the Neon Mile so the pink GT, the traffic ahead and three neon signs share the frame.

scenes.lens: 62 degree game FOV at 3.6 m height — wide enough to keep all four cruisers and the officer in frame at once.
scenes.name: chase
scenes.note: Proves the wanted system: 4 stars lit on the HUD, the BUSTED meter creeping, police blips crowding the minimap and the 'Lose the police' objective.
scenes.rig: Shoulder-height camera behind the player's coupe on the harbour road, four cruisers fanned across the lanes behind with light bars strobing, one officer posed on the sidewalk with pistol raised.

scenes.lens: 62 degree game FOV pulled to 5 m — the on-foot camera at its tightest, so Jax, the stalls and the crowd all read clearly.
scenes.name: onfoot
scenes.note: Proves the on-foot game: third-person character, market crowd, story dialogue, the objective marker 12 m out and pistol ammo on the HUD.
scenes.rig: Close over-the-shoulder camera behind Jax among the Old Market stalls, pedestrians mid-stroll around him, Odile's dialogue box open at the bottom of the screen.

scenes.lens: 62 degree game FOV at the standard 10.6 m driving distance — exactly what the player sees mid-mission.
scenes.name: mission
scenes.note: Proves a timed story mission in flight: 'Nine Minutes to Dock Nine' objective with 96 seconds on the countdown and the delivery marker 47 m ahead.
scenes.rig: Driving camera behind the Dockmaster Pickup on the harbour run, the neon TATTOO sign ahead on the left, oncoming traffic in the far lane.
